# Experiment DLG-EXP-005 of docs/spec/dialog.md, section 16: values.
# Source: the capture of the wire between the vanilla client and the vanilla server, in the play
# phase. A line has the time in seconds, the direction, the phase, the packet id, the packet name,
# the length of the packet in bytes and the packet bytes in hexadecimal. The capture keeps at most
# 400 bytes of a packet.
# Lines that start with "# " are notes of the fixture. The other lines are the raw capture lines.
# The line numbers in these notes count the raw capture lines only.
# Lines 1 to 3, show_dialog, id 143: an inline dialog with the VarInt 0, the after action none
# and a list of 5 inputs. The capture cuts off the rest.
# Lines 4 and 5, custom_click_action, id 68: the id "t:dyn", the payload length 66 and one
# network NBT compound. Its keys and values are:
#   msg   String  a"b\c'x            (7 code units: a, quote, b, backslash, c, apostrophe, x)
#   opt   String  q
#   flag  Byte    1
#   extra Byte    5
#   num   Float   7.0
#   ml    String  l1, a line feed, l, a quote, 2
# The string values keep their quote, backslash, apostrophe and line feed with no escape.
#
